DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML).

The MRI results showing multifocal demyelinating lesions without enhancement are classic for PML, a rare opportunistic viral infection of the white matter that typically affects immunocompromised patients. Given your significant medical history, do you have a condition that suppresses your immune system, such as HIV/AIDS, or are you currently taking immunosuppressive medications?
